_wipes: Page-wipe label by URL regex, first match wins.
_beats: One line per beat; a beat lasts its line plus edit.voPad. Per-take numbers go in callouts, not lines (they would miss the TTS cache).

beats.line: AppShelf sells hosted WordPress sites for nine dollars a month, billed with Stripe.
Pick one of three starter templates.
Sign up in seconds. There's no email check in this demo.
Choose a template, name the site, and pick a free address.
Then pay on Stripe Checkout, in test mode, with Stripe's own test card number.
Stripe sends a webhook, and a worker builds the WordPress site.
And just like that, it's live.
Here's the new restaurant site, ready to edit.
Cancel the plan, and the licence turns inactive right away.
Visitors now see a notice that the site is archived.
Renew it from the dashboard, and pay again with the same test card.

endLine: Built with Next.js, Postgres, Stripe and WordPress.
